_meta.name: KlarSchiff construction-materials tariff knowledge base
_meta.nomenclature: Harmonized System 2022 (6-digit), used as the base of the EU Combined Nomenclature (CN, 8-digit) and TARIC (10-digit)
_meta.scope: Curated subset for one construction-materials importer/exporter. Not a full tariff. Every suggestion must be confirmed in TARIC (EU) or the HTS (US) before filing.
sources: EU Combined Nomenclature (Annex I to Council Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87), updated every year - verify the current year's version
_meta.reviewed_by: Janaina Hoffmann (consultant) - to be re-verified by a licensed customs broker during the pilot
